programmes.d: J. Nicole is a determined mother, entrepreneur and hairstylist fighting to balance her personal and professional worlds while navigating love, family and the weight of false perceptions. By day, she runs her salon with pride, presenting herself.

Getting out of rehab, losing his girlfriend, and the death of his mother; life has been rough for Travis. Determined to fix his life, Travis gets sober. That is until he meets, Pearl, a girl more dangerous than his addictions.

College student, Quan, is presented with an opportunity too good to turn down. When she lets her sister, Bree, in on the deal, she takes it to the next level. Soon Quan realizes they both are in too deep, and is faced with the consequences.
Jeremy is held back from his dream of being a news anchor by his friends and his lack of focus until he realigns his life by finding faith in God and himself.
A one-night stand leads to life-changing consequences for a man and woman.
Detectives Trent Rollins and Latoya Cooper investigate a series of murders in which the victims all bear a mysterious symbol that's connected to a previous murder of a known artist, Preston Sacher.

When rival gangster Derrick Smith is released from prison, the beef with Armand Rossi explodes into an all-out war in Fountain City. After a hit on his family, Armand goes into killer mode. Derrick and Vic Moore team up for revenge.

Destitute and desperate, China is forced to the edge, taking up work as a truck stop sex worker just to survive. Into this grim reality storms Ze, who has come to town seeking vengeance on Angie's sister-the woman who murdered his brother, Tez.

When a blind date ends in a shootout, Krystal Gray is left with more questions than answers. She discovers a flash drive linked to the murder and a web of secrets involving her brother, a dirty cop, and a mysterious man named Jarrell.

While Todd is away at Graduate school to better his family, his wife Janice is back home taking care of her sick mother. The long distance marriage takes a toll on the two. When Todd ends up encountering a woman named Sharon at a bar, sparks fly.
